title: Web Development Foundations
description: Build confidence with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, links, and accessible page structure.

questions.q: Which language describes the structure and meaning of a web page?
questions.explanation: HTML marks up page content and structure. CSS controls presentation, while JavaScript adds behavior.

questions.q: Which technology is mainly used to control colors, spacing, and typography on a web page?
questions.explanation: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) control how HTML content is presented.

questions.q: Which HTML element creates a hyperlink?
questions.explanation: The anchor element, <a>, creates a link. Its href attribute supplies the destination.

questions.q: Which attribute tells a link where to go?
questions.explanation: The href attribute contains the URL or page location that an anchor should open.

questions.q: What is the main purpose of JavaScript in a web page?
questions.explanation: JavaScript can respond to user actions, update page content, and implement interactive features.

questions.q: Which element is the most appropriate landmark for the main unique content of a page?
questions.explanation: The <main> landmark identifies the central content and helps assistive technology users navigate a page.

questions.q: What does responsive web design aim to do?
options: Adapt layouts to different screen sizes
Make every page load without a network
Convert a website into a spreadsheet
questions.ans: Adapt layouts to different screen sizes
questions.explanation: Responsive layouts adapt content to phones, tablets, and desktop screens.

questions.q: What does HTTPS help provide for data sent between a browser and a website?
options: A guarantee that every website is honest
questions.explanation: HTTPS encrypts the connection. It does not by itself prove that a site or its content is trustworthy.

title: Computer Science Essentials
description: Review algorithms, data, hardware, programming concepts, and databases.

questions.q: What is an algorithm?
options: A clear sequence of steps for solving a problem
A password stored in a browser
questions.ans: A clear sequence of steps for solving a problem
questions.explanation: An algorithm describes a finite, ordered method for completing a task or solving a problem.

questions.q: Which part of a computer carries out program instructions?
questions.explanation: The central processing unit executes instructions and performs calculations.

questions.q: What is a common characteristic of RAM?
options: It permanently stores every file without power
questions.explanation: RAM holds data programs are currently using and is generally cleared when the computer powers off.

questions.q: How many different digits are used in the binary number system?
questions.explanation: Binary uses two digits, 0 and 1, to represent values.

questions.q: In programming, what is a variable commonly used for?
options: Giving a name to a value that a program can use
Connecting a computer to a printer
questions.ans: Giving a name to a value that a program can use
questions.explanation: A variable is a named reference to data used by a program.

questions.q: What does a loop do in a program?
questions.explanation: Loops repeat instructions while a condition holds or for each item in a sequence.

questions.q: In a relational database table, what does a row usually represent?
questions.explanation: Each row stores one record, with columns describing its fields.

questions.q: Which description best fits open-source software?
options: Its source code is available under a license that allows specified use and sharing
It can only run without internet
It is always free of all conditions
questions.ans: Its source code is available under a license that allows specified use and sharing
questions.explanation: Open-source licenses make source code available and permit certain uses; each license still has terms.

title: Mathematics & Data Reasoning
description: Practice percentages, averages, geometry, ratios, equations, and probability.

questions.q: What is 25% of 80?
questions.explanation: 25% is one quarter, and one quarter of 80 is 20.

questions.q: What is the mean of 4, 6, and 8?
questions.explanation: Add the values (4 + 6 + 8 = 18) and divide by the three values: 18 ÷ 3 = 6.

questions.q: Solve for x: x + 7 = 12
questions.explanation: Subtract 7 from both sides: x = 12 − 7 = 5.

questions.q: What is the sum of the interior angles of a triangle?
questions.explanation: The three interior angles of every Euclidean triangle add up to 180 degrees.

questions.q: A rectangle is 8 cm long and 3 cm wide. What is its area?
questions.explanation: Area of a rectangle is length × width: 8 × 3 = 24 square centimetres.

questions.q: A bag has 2 red and 3 blue counters. What is the probability of picking a red counter at random?
questions.explanation: There are 2 favorable counters out of 5 counters in total, so the probability is 2/5.

questions.q: The ratio of apples to oranges is 2:3. If there are 25 fruits, how many are apples?
questions.explanation: There are 5 equal parts altogether. Each part is 25 ÷ 5 = 5, so apples are 2 × 5 = 10.

questions.q: Which decimal is equal to 3/4?
questions.explanation: Divide 3 by 4 to get 0.75.

title: General Science: Core Ideas
description: Explore forces, cells, matter, Earth, sound, and photosynthesis.

questions.q: Which gas do plants take in from the air during photosynthesis?
questions.explanation: Plants use carbon dioxide and water, with light energy, to make sugars and release oxygen.

questions.q: What is the basic structural unit of living organisms?
questions.explanation: Cells are the basic structural and functional units of living things.

questions.q: What is the SI unit of force?
questions.explanation: Force is measured in newtons, named after physicist Isaac Newton.

questions.q: What motion of Earth causes the cycle of day and night?
questions.explanation: As Earth rotates, different regions face toward or away from the Sun.

questions.q: What is the chemical formula for water?
questions.explanation: A water molecule contains two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

questions.q: Which organ pumps blood around the human body?
questions.explanation: The heart contracts to move blood through the circulatory system.

questions.q: Which state of matter has a fixed shape and a fixed volume?
questions.explanation: A solid keeps its shape and volume; a liquid keeps volume but takes the container's shape.

questions.q: Why can sound not travel through a vacuum?
options: Sound needs particles to carry vibrations
questions.ans: Sound needs particles to carry vibrations
questions.explanation: Sound is a mechanical wave and needs a medium with particles to pass on its vibrations.

title: Digital Citizenship & Cyber Safety
description: Make thoughtful choices about passwords, messages, privacy, updates, and online conduct.

questions.q: Which password practice is safest?
options: Use a long, unique password for each important account
Use your birthday as every password
questions.ans: Use a long, unique password for each important account
questions.explanation: Unique passwords limit the damage if one service is compromised. A password manager can help keep track of them.

questions.q: What does multi-factor authentication add to a sign-in?
options: Another proof of identity besides the password
questions.ans: Another proof of identity besides the password
questions.explanation: Multi-factor authentication asks for an additional factor, such as an authenticator code or security key.

questions.q: A message says your account will close unless you open an unfamiliar link immediately. What is the safest first response?
options: Do not open the link; verify the message through the service's official app or website
Download the attachment to check it
questions.ans: Do not open the link; verify the message through the service's official app or website
questions.explanation: Urgent threats and unfamiliar links are common phishing signals. Verify using a known official channel.

questions.q: What is a sensible way to handle a software security update?
options: Install it from the device or software's official update feature
Download a copy from a random message
Share the update file with strangers
questions.ans: Install it from the device or software's official update feature
questions.explanation: Updates from official channels often fix security problems. Avoid installers from unknown sources.

questions.q: Before posting a photo of a friend online, what should you do?
options: Tag their school and daily schedule
questions.explanation: Respect others' privacy and ask before sharing identifiable photos or personal information.

questions.q: Which statement about a padlock icon or HTTPS is accurate?
options: It indicates an encrypted connection, but does not prove the site is trustworthy
It proves every claim on the site is true
It guarantees a site has no malware
It means the site cannot collect data
questions.ans: It indicates an encrypted connection, but does not prove the site is trustworthy
questions.explanation: HTTPS protects data in transit; you still need to check that the site and request are legitimate.

questions.q: If someone is being bullied online, which is a constructive action?
options: Save evidence and report it to a trusted adult or the platform
questions.ans: Save evidence and report it to a trusted adult or the platform
questions.explanation: Keep evidence, use reporting tools, and seek help from a trusted adult. Avoid escalating or sharing private details.

questions.q: Why should important files have a backup?
options: A backup helps restore files after loss, damage, or device failure
It automatically checks every fact online
questions.ans: A backup helps restore files after loss, damage, or device failure
questions.explanation: Backups provide another copy so data can be restored after accidental deletion, hardware failure, or other loss.
